design_impact.reason: The model does not provide an executable observation encoder or composite-action decoder, and its published network is incompatible with its own checkpoint.
design_impact.safe_lesson: Any future learned policy must freeze the exact nested-observation encoder, macro/action decoder, network source, checkpoint, training engine, and both-seat evaluation receipts as one contract.

environment_contract.action: object with farmer action, zero-or-more hand actions, and zero-or-more market orders in the same turn

falsifiers_that_would_allow_reassessment: Exact source for a module whose names and tensor shapes match fc1(10,64) and fc2(64,4), including activation semantics.
Exact ordered and normalized 10-feature encoder from the nested Kaggriculture observation.
Exact mapping from four Q-value indices to legal composite farmer/hands/market actions, including dynamic hand counts and market quantities.
Hash-pinned training engine, reward, replay/training logs, seed protocol, and both-seat evaluation against known controls.
A checkpoint-loading and 720-turn execution receipt for those exact bytes.
observed_incompatibilities: README advertises a 10->256->128->4 Sequential with six parameter keys; checkpoint has a 10->64->4 two-layer state dict with four keys.
README example points at version /3/ while the current public model is version 8.
API usage advertises the same 256/128 architecture under module name network, which also cannot match fc1/fc2 keys.
Four scalar Q outputs have no supplied mapping to Kaggriculture's structured, variable-cardinality action object.
